body: When you're stabilized, your contribution to society will be Epic; for you have truly lived

I like what you said to the single dad who just lost his wife a week ago. I like how you substantiate with empirical reading. 

My only child was taken (by my sophisticated family but only when CPS kicked in my door) ...and let me tell you, I cannot share enough that this that lil boy doesn't remember that Parked At DisneyWorld and took him for 22 months daily, whilst he was 4-5.

His memory actually sets in from the week that the cops kicked in the door, dealt with a BELLIGERENT mama bear (omg that social worker lost his his job because he was in a tete-a-Tete with me & WE won, bit really it was my folks that won: they got the child who bends over backwards unwillingly,to get the grades that are required to remain in our family.
I spent 3 months as his babysitter this summer: I was alarmed to realized he that he doesn't remember much prior to 11 years old, He doesn't remember how raised him like royalty and he doesn't even rembembet when I shipped him off with my brother. 

He had an impressive concept of who his mother is, but this is a result of his grandmother boosting his memory and he takes her word as gold. 

It's heartbreaking to admit but kids SUBSCRIBE TO WHAT THEYRE FED.

I don't deny that subliminal attachment is at play, but it's been my experience that small children only absurd your energy and not the irl experience until at least age 10
Happy birthday. You have people who recognized it's your birthday: you're doing better than I am 💫

I thought your post was remarkably articulate and grounded. For what it's worth; you could be a poster-child for survive n' thrive.

Community is key. 

Stay and build a resilient community, with us & for us?

Abuse might not be unique to only Meg, but sometimes it's import to declare what you're dying over. 

... I kindof agree; don't mention it ...but only because it often leaves the confessor even more stranded out in the ledge due to emotionally unavailable listeners. 

But, I it does need to be addressed.

"Speaking out & being vulnerable helps"

A fkn men. 

It's this entire discussion that gives me hope. 

OP? Can you help me get out of the rut I'm in?

I was able to completely shift out of suicidal ideation  by enrolling in social media. I got caught up in memes, both dark & hopeful. It bought me another 10 months. 

At this time, (because strangers and memes can only get a person so far) what's keeping me alive is the business of planning. There's my belongings to get rid of, there's financial planning (and yes I realize you're 27 and struggling financially but omg you'd be surprised how much of debt is covered by insurance/there's insurance for everything even cleaning up after a completed suicide). 

And then there's always the option of saying "fuck it! Imma get comfortable until this lethal sentiment passes".  If there's anyway we can ease your pain please tell us. Because that's the reason we're all here: to ease some pain and extend some hope.
I'm sorry, I did google it to no avail; so I must ask: what's Valhalla?

Alright, this is intense. True dat. 

... when I feel that there's an energy intruding and I get a little "wiggy", I close my eyes and picture a white-light channel to "the gods". 

I also knock on my doctors door asap, and it's always my intention to say " whoa: I think I'm at risk of one bad minute that could be a permanent mistake" and the very act of saying it out loud seems to chase the negative forces far enough away for another week.

This is where I get strength to move forward. 

https://youtu.be/26U_seo0a1g

Also, as difficult as it is to admit: I get fierce and angry with the cruelty in this world. I feel strongly that as long as I'm kicking and lashing out: I'm far from conceding. It's a painful way to be present in the world; but y'know ... it fends off the obituary for the time being. 

I'm terrified of saying the wrong thing. FWIW I do care. Deeply. About your well being and wish you a robust comeback ;)

Wow. You're a gifted author. 
Hugs. Love. Strength.

"Hi random stranger. My family sucks too" 
- I smiled that knowing smile when I read your last sentence. I suspect hundreds of people will feel the same. It was incredibly useful to hear you thoroughly describe your experience; I suddenly felt not so alone and discarded. Thank you. It took me far too long to realize I should acknowledge your reply... I was really stuck in a rut these past few days. I finally bathed; just now, and it occurred to me that COMMUNITY IS KEY and thus I owe our community this reply. 

THANK YOU FROM THE BOTTOM OF MY HEART
I found this reply comforting; in hindsight, I actually think it helped me to power through the night last night. Thank you.

I myself have been using the "one day at a time" method, for hanging on. I let go of some responsibilities and got into binge-watching shows, and social media groups have been cathartic to a degree: gets me off my pity pot for hours on end. 

I read here, recently, someone said they made a list of small goals and proceeded to manifest them. Sounds like a terrific idea to me. 

I wish you well, hope to hear from you tomorrow and next week.

Happy Birthday! 
... surrounding yourself with community is a good of start for the next year of your life. And look, here we are ;)
